title: Ooze-covered Letter
wikitext:
The '''Ooze-covered Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Ooze-covered Letter (quest)|Ooze-covered Letter|race=Goblin|class=rogue}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Thief! Scoundrel! Son of a Gnome!

Don't think I didn't hear you were skulking around up here, <name>. You got some nerve showing your face in the same operation as Leyti Quicktongue.

You stole my gig, the greatest heist this side of Azeroth! I would have been filthy rich and vanished without a trace!

Until you bungled in and screwed everything up. You went and got yourself caught, and I'll bet you're not laboring for Venture Co. because you wanted to.

No matter. Come by the collapsed cave and give me back the money you owe me! Maybe you could learn a thing or two from a real Rogue.
}}
